t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick each colour in turn, try remember which scores highest. apparently this may change though

vb_textbox.text: Quickly experiment between color groups (i.e the different shades of purple vs different shades of yellow), when you establish which color group produces the most mushrooms, stick with that until the amount the number of mushrooms reduces, or that color group is no longer available, at this point you repeat the process.
